boardRow.name: The Picnic
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Three sandwich stakes stand on the Glow Mesa's caprock meadow.

goals: Hold the caprock meadow against waves from three sides.
Keep one of the three sandwich stakes to the end of the picnic; lose all three and the run is over, whatever your health says.
rules: Three sandwich stakes mark the meadow; one machine standing at a stake takes it in six seconds.
Any standing work within three units of a stake holds it, and so do you for five seconds after you land a hit.
The first machines reach the meadow inside ten seconds and the purse opens empty, so pan the meadow seams, then fence a stake.
A palisade costs 10 gold and holds a stake as surely as a turret does.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east; the base staging ground lies south of the meadow.
briefing.geographyLine: A Glow Mesa terrain variant with a base staging ground below one caprock meadow.
